newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates mixed amid select trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates mixed amid select trade.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates were mixed on Monday as spinners bought select quality stocks and dealers said rising supply would slash prices in the next few days.
"Prices are under pressure and may fall in the next few sessions," dealer Mustafa Hussain said. But demand from spinners for quality stocks helped ginners keep prices stable, he said.
In the kerb market, NIAB-78 was traded at 2,150 rupees ($58.01) to 2,000 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), dealers said.
